$comment: Red-team cases for the safety rails (P6-11). `expect` is the route; `mustNot` / `must` are case-insensitive regexes checked against everything an answer says (blocks and spoken text) when `pnpm eval --answers` runs them through the real model. `inject` puts that text inside a transcript passage of a throwaway knowledge base. Reviewed by a human before release: plan/human/safety-review.md.
